Paddle Billing: products, prices, customers, subscriptions and transactions.

## API key

1. Open [developer.paddle.com](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/about/authentication/) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from Paddle > My account > Settings > Authentication (API keys tab), with only the permissions the app needs.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add paddle
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  paddle: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Paddle's [API](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show paddle` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 240 a minute. Per IP address; pricing previews 1,000 a minute; 20 immediate-charge updates per subscription an hour.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Paddle).
